findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_tables · Public sink: filing_list, ticker_lookup, run_sql, news_search · Destructive: run_sql, ai_adoption.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_tables · Public sink: filing_list, ticker_lookup, run_sql, news_search · Destructive: run_sql, ai_adoption

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
